zb: ZB is a unit of information equal to 1000 exabits or 10^21 bits.
ZB can also mean a unit of information equal to 1000 exabytes or 10^21 bytes.
ZB can also mean a unit of information equal to 1024 exbibytes or 2^70 bytes.
ZB means the same as zettabit or Zbit or zettabyte.
zbit: Zbit is a unit of information equal to 1000 exabits or 10^21 bits.
Zbit means the same as zettabit or Zb.
